With no narrative the summary says it is not yet written; when timeline.json carries one, its paragraphs are
shown as text (HTML in it is escaped, not run).
source: @pytest.mark.req("PROV-05") def test_narrative_placeholder_and_rendering(browser, server): """With no narrative the summary says it is not yet written; when timeline.json carries one, its paragraphs are shown as text (HTML in it is escaped, not run).""" if D["narrative"] is None: p = open_page(browser, server, "view=summary") assert "Narrative not yet written" in p.inner_text("#narrative") p.close() data = {**D, "narrative": "# Why\n\nI wrote every spec.\n\nClaude wrote the code. "} p = open_page(browser, server, "view=summary", data=data) body = p.locator("#narrative-body") assert body.locator("h3").inner_text() == "Why" assert body.locator("p").all_inner_texts() == ["I wrote every spec.", "Claude wrote the code. "] assert body.locator("img").count() == 0 p.close()
